newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banerj deal vote seen unlikely Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banerj deal vote seen unlikely Tuesday.

text.p: A Senate vote on a deal resolving debts of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj is unlikely to take place Tuesday, an official said.

Government leaders had been expected to send a motion to the Senate requesting the Banerj deal to be made a priority so that it could be put to a vote on the floor of the upper house without prior approval from a Senate panel.
But so far no request has been sent yet, said the Senate official.
Earlier the Senate's Economic Affairs Committee delayed a vote on the deal because it failed to gather enough senators to hold the voting session.
The committee is likely to meet again only Thursday, she said.
The Senate approval is key to allow Rio de Janeiro state government to go ahead with its plans to privatize Banerj.
The auction, previously scheduled for 1400 local/1700 GMT, is on hold pending the approval.
